name: Stepping Bloom
design_intent:
MEADOW MILE #15 — five small committed pads (680px each) over a DEEP void with 600px gaps and mild height jitter, plus one central spring throne. The peak of the calm tier: little landing runway means every crossing is a real commit and a whiff is a long fall, but there is no hazard — just nerve and fuel over the deepest meadow void.

GEOMETRY: P1 (trampoline x0..680 top1080) / P2 (bubblegum x1280..1960 top1000) / P3 (trampoline x2560..3240 top1120) / P4 (bubblegum x3760..4440 top1020) / P5 (trampoline x4960..5640 top1080), four 600px void gaps with a mild up/down jitter. One central spring THRONE (x2720..3080 top560 h48) hovers 520px above P3. Full-width DEEP lethal void (rim y1260); bounds -560..6200, ~560px side runway; bottom y2000 leaves 760-868px of deep recovery sky.

MOVEMENT (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; zero-boost drift ~395 tramp / ~320 bubblegum / ~527 spring max; normal_boost_max 760 crosses a 600px gap in ~0.9s @ ~25 fuel, bounce refunds +20; super 2800 clears all):
- GAPS P1..P5 (four x 600px over deep void): each > 527 max spring drift and >> 395/320 drift; the small 680px pads give little landing margin so a mistimed boost falls. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED at every gap; miss = a long fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top560): 520px above P3 (1120)... trampoline apex 270 from P3 reaches y850 -> 290px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: pad bottoms (1112-1240) to bottom blast (2000) = 760-888px of deep recovery sky (>= 650) -> a fuelled knock-off has a long boost-back gamble; a near-brink smash spikes past the rim. Verb: FLY.
- Every gap exceeds a spring bounce's reach and the throne sits above spring apex, so flight is required to move across or up. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.
